statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the requested variant has not been modified since the time specified in If-Modified-Since, a stream will not be set up (SETUP). Instead, a 304 (Not Modified) response MUST be returned without any message body.
actions: send 304 Not Modified response without message body

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the requested variant has not been modified since the time specified in If-Modified-Since, a description will not be returned from the server (DESCRIBE). Instead, a 304 (Not Modified) response MUST be returned without any message body.
actions: send 304 Not Modified response without message body
